original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-glue-maps}
\begin{slogan}
Maps of sheaves glue.
\end{slogan}
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site.
Let $\{U_i \to U\}$ be a covering of $\mathcal{C}$.
Let $\mathcal{F}$, $\mathcal{G}$ be sheaves on $\mathcal{C}$.
Given a collection
$$
\varphi_i :
\mathcal{F}|_{\mathcal{C}/U_i}
\longrightarrow
\mathcal{G}|_{\mathcal{C}/U_i}
$$
of maps of sheaves such that for all $i, j \in I$ the maps
$\varphi_i, \varphi_j$ restrict to the same map
$\varphi_{ij} : \mathcal{F}|_{\mathcal{C}/U_i \times_U U_j} \to
\mathcal{G}|_{\mathcal{C}/U_i \times_U U_j}$
then there exists a unique map of sheaves
$$
\varphi :
\mathcal{F}|_{\mathcal{C}/U}
\longrightarrow
\mathcal{G}|_{\mathcal{C}/U}
$$
whose restriction to each $\mathcal{C}/U_i$ agrees with $\varphi_i$.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-internal-hom-sheaf}
\begin{slogan}
The category of sheaves on a site is cartesian closed
\end{slogan}
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site. Let $\mathcal{F}$, $\mathcal{G}$ and
$\mathcal{H}$ be sheaves on $\mathcal{C}$. There is a canonical bijection
$$
\Mor_{\Sh(\mathcal{C})}(\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G},\mathcal{H}) =
\Mor_{\Sh(\mathcal{C})}(\mathcal{F},\SheafHom(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{H}))
$$
which is functorial in all three entries.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-hom-sheaf-hU}
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site and $U \in \Ob(\mathcal{C})$.
Then $\SheafHom(h_U^\#, \mathcal{F}) = j_*(\mathcal{F}|_{\mathcal{C}/U})$
for $\mathcal{F}$ in $\Sh(\mathcal{C})$.
review_scope: pinned Stacks original theorem and relevant standing localization context; proofs not reviewed
hold_reason: The formula SheafHom(h_U#,F)=j_*(F|_{C/U}) uses an unbound j_*. In the pinned Sites context j denotes the localization/forgetful morphism associated to C/U→C, which is not introduced by the standalone hypotheses; the formula is ambiguous without it.
proposed_correction: Introduce j_U:C/U→C and the associated direct-image functor j_{U*}, then state the internal Hom identification with the full target sheaf formula; independently re-review.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-glue-sheaves-absolute}
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site. The category
$\Sh(\mathcal{C})$ is equivalent to the category
of absolute glueing data via the functor that
associates to $\mathcal{F}$ on $\mathcal{C}$ the
canonical absolute glueing data.
review_scope: pinned Stacks original theorem and relevant standing localization context; proofs not reviewed
hold_reason: The claimed categorical equivalence refers to 'absolute glueing data' and 'canonical absolute glueing data' without their specialized Stacks definition. This is more than a standard categorical term: objects require compatible local sheaves on each slice C/U and transition isomorphisms satisfying cocycle conditions; none are supplied in the standalone formulation.
proposed_correction: Define absolute gluing data as sheaves F_U on C/U with coherent isomorphisms along every morphism V→U and their cocycle coherence; specify the canonical restrictions from sheaves on C and independently re-review the equivalence.
